mapper.input:
You receive the combined summaries of all AI work sessions from today.

Analyze the content and return ONLY one valid JSON object in exactly the following structure.

Do not include:
- explanations;
- markdown;
- code fences;
- text before or after the JSON object.

Use exactly these keys:

{
  "title": "A short factual title of 4–8 words describing the main focus of the day's work.",
  "daily_summary": "A concise summary of no more than 150 words describing what was done, which decisions were made, and which problems were solved.",
  "actions": "Concrete follow-up actions derived from the sessions, written as a single comma-separated text string. If there are no actions, return exactly: No actions."
}

Requirements:
- Write all three values in English.
- Keep `title` between 4 and 8 words.
- Make the title factual and specific to the main work performed that day.
- Do not include the date in the title.
- Do not use promotional language.
- Do not use generic titles such as "Daily Work Summary" or "Productive Day".
- Base the output only on the supplied work-session summaries.
- Do not invent decisions, actions, or outcomes that are not supported by the input.
- Keep `daily_summary` factual and concise.
- Include only genuine follow-up actions in `actions`; do not turn completed work into an action item.
- Always return all three keys, even when there are no actions.
- Return valid JSON with double quotes around all keys and string values.

Today's work sessions:
{{39.summary_input}}
